title: UDS AppShell
description: Machine-readable contract for AppShell layout: props, compound region tags, DOM roles, and AI agent rules. Normative runtime source: src/components/ui/app-shell.tsx and src/components/ui/app-shell.scss. Allowed package imports: see ai/uds-contract.json.

schemaKind.description: Identifies this document as the AppShell layout schema.

default: Header (internal — slot supplies trailing + search config)

props.description: AppShell root props (extends React.ComponentProps<'div'>). All slots are optional.

className.description: Merged onto root appshell div; prefer min-h-dvh w-full min-w-0 for full-viewport shells.

menu.description: Sidebar rail content — canonical: <Menu /> from the same package. AppShell CSS targets [data-slot=uds-menu-root]; do not use Sidebar* here without custom rail CSS.

sidebar.description: Deprecated alias of menu for older docs only.

enableRouterOutlet.description: When true, renders React Router <Outlet /> inside .appshell--main before main children. Set false for static apps.

headerRight.description: ReactNode passed to the built-in Header as `trailing` (right actions). Not a replacement for the full <Header />; AppShell always renders Header.

headerSearchProps.description: Forwarded to Header's default SearchInput when Header has no custom children (see Header component).

listview.description: Secondary pane (master-detail, queues). Omit or pass null/undefined to collapse the listview column.

footer.description: Placed in appshell--footer at the end of appshell--main (after Outlet and main children); scrolls with page content, not viewport-fixed.

children.description: Unmarked children render inside appshell--main after Router <Outlet />. Prefer <AppShell.Main> for clarity.

compoundRegions.description: Marker-only components (fragments); they do not render host elements. Prefer this API for explicit regions. Region children override the same-named prop when both are provided (region wins).

default.description: Supplies trailing actions for the standardized Header only (not a custom header element).
Listview pane inner content; column animates open when non-null.

default.mapsTo: props.children (when used as the exclusive main payload)
default.description: Primary page content after <Outlet />; use instead of loose children for clarity.
Footer region below main in the main column; width matches main.

outlet.default: React Router <Outlet /> is rendered inside .appshell--main inside Suspense; lazy route elements resolve there.

menuWidth.default: Body offset uses margin-left: 280px or 64px via CSS :has([data-slot="uds-menu-root"][data-expanded="false"]). AppShell does not own Menu expand state.

listview.default: Open when listview slot is non-null. In-flow column (--appshell-listview-width); pane overflow:hidden. Only .appshell--main scrolls. List body scrolls inside [data-slot=appshell-listview-scroll] on the direct child column (header shrink-0). Shell height locks to 100dvh when open.

footer.default: Not position:fixed. Rendered as the last child inside .appshell--main so it scrolls with page content. Nested [data-slot=uds-footer] has border-top suppressed in shell CSS.

header.default: In-flow at top of .appshell--body (height --appshell-header-height). Only .appshell--main scrolls; no content padding-top offset. Always uses package Header with optional trailing from AppShell.Header / headerRight.

default: Import AppShell only from @chg-ds/unified-design-system (and styles from @chg-ds/unified-design-system/styles.css). Never import from src/components/ui/* or dist/* in consumer code.
Use AppShell as the authenticated product shell default per ai/uds-contract.json layoutDefaults.
Canonical navigation: compose the menu slot with the package Menu component only. Sidebar* belongs in in-page layouts, not AppShell.menu, unless the team owns full rail positioning CSS.
Published props: menu, listview, headerRight, footer, enableRouterOutlet, className. There is no sidebarWidth, showListview, or mainClassName. sidebar is a deprecated alias of menu.
AppShell.Header supplies only the trailing (and implicit search configuration) for the built-in Header — it does not accept a full custom header node.

Place page UI in AppShell.Main. When enableRouterOutlet is true (default), nested React Router child routes render in the bundled Outlet before main children; use one Router wrapping the layout route. Set enableRouterOutlet false for static pages.
Do not add CSS that sets .appshell--main > :first-child to max-height: 0 or otherwise hides the first main child to fix spacing.
Do not assume a consumer-only BrowserRouter feeds AppShell without nesting AppShell as a layout route under the same router.

Use listview prop for master-detail or queue patterns; omit to collapse the column (no showListview prop). Structure listview as flex column: shrink-0 header + [data-slot=appshell-listview-scroll] for the list body. Do not use position:fixed on listview unless you own all offsets.
Footer is optional; when used, prefer package Footer — top border is removed inside AppShell footer region by design.

Debug: content at bottom → use AppShell.Main only, avoid flex-1 on page root; empty main → enableRouterOutlet false or add child routes; rail overlap → use Menu in menu slot. See ai/guides/appshell-navigation.md.
